provider_receipt.summary: Review completed with three named defects. TG-001: critical-risk invocations can reach review_required without a trace when requires_review=false and mutates_state=false, because trace enforcement precedes and does not use the computed critical-risk review condition (src/policy.rs:89,129). TG-002: decision receipts are not bound to invocation_id or tool_id, so receipts—especially trace-less read-only allows—cannot independently identify the invocation they authorize (src/receipt.rs:20-27, src/policy.rs:186-193). TG-003: requested_at_utc is validated only as nonblank, permitting arbitrary non-date content and weakening audit evidence (src/types.rs:71-82). Evidence limitation: the parent receipt authenticates only a clean tracked tree; it provides no build, test, schema-conformance, or policy-behavior evidence, so implementation correctness is not supported by the declared verification receipt alone. No project files were modified.
